title: Proprietorship vs LLP vs Pvt Ltd - kaun winner?
hooks: Proprietorship, LLP, Pvt Ltd — kisne bachaya sabse zyada tax?
30% flat, 25% effective, ya slab — tera kaun sa?
Ghar pe risk, audit ka jhanjhat — decide kar ab
hook_why: Opens with the three structures and a direct money question (who saved most tax) in friend tone, matches the channel's comparison format, promises a clear winner.
metaphor: A phone screen that becomes your decision tool: three cards flip to show risk, tax, audit, funding — you tap, you see, you choose.

caption:
Proprietorship, LLP, Pvt Ltd — kisne bachaya sabse zyada tax?

Risk: Proprietorship unlimited, LLP-Pvt Ltd limited.
Tax: Slab vs 30% flat vs ~25% effective.
Audit: >1Cr, >40L, har saal.
Funding: Sirf Pvt Ltd VC ready.
OPC solo ke liye, par convert karna padega.

Source: IT Act 1961, LLP Act 2008, Companies Act 2013 (FY 25-26 rates)

Save karo, kaam aayega 📌

Tera kaun sa? Comment bata.

#personalfinance #financeinhindi #moneytips #businessstructure #startupindia #taxplanning #llp #pvtltd

claims.claim: Proprietorship taxed at individual slab rates for FY 2025-26
claims.basis: Income Tax Act 1961 (still applicable for FY 2025-26 returns per taxgst.in)

claims.claim: LLP taxed at 30% plus surcharge and cess
claims.basis: taxgst.in comparison table and skla.in — flat 30% + surcharge & cess

claims.claim: Private Limited effective tax ~25.17% under Section 115BAA
claims.basis: taxgst.in: '22% under Section 115BAA plus applicable surcharge and cess — about 25.17% effective'; skla.in confirms ~25.17% effective

claims.claim: LLP audit required only if turnover exceeds ₹40 lakh or contribution exceeds ₹25 lakh
claims.basis: taxgst.in comparison table: 'Audit: Only if turnover exceeds ₹40 lakh or contribution exceeds ₹25 lakh'

claims.claim: Private Limited statutory audit mandatory every year
claims.basis: taxgst.in comparison table: 'Audit: Statutory audit mandatory every year'

claims.claim: Proprietorship has unlimited liability — personal assets exposed
claims.basis: taxgst.in: 'Liability: Unlimited — personal assets exposed'; rdatax.in: 'The simplest and cheapest, and the riskiest.'

claims.claim: LLP and Pvt Ltd have limited liability
claims.basis: taxgst.in: LLP 'Limited to the agreed contribution', Pvt Ltd 'Limited to shareholding'; skla.in confirms both are separate legal entities with capped liability

claims.claim: Private Limited is the standard structure for raising venture capital
claims.basis: rdatax.in: 'If you intend to raise external equity… the choice is effectively made for you: you need a Private Limited company'; skla.in: 'Raising equity: Standard — angels & VCs'

claims.claim: OPC has single shareholder and must convert to Pvt Ltd to raise equity
claims.basis: rdatax.in: 'An OPC has only one shareholder by definition, so it cannot bring in an investor without first converting to a Private Limited'

claims.claim: New Income Tax Act 2025 applies from tax year 2026-27; FY 2025-26 still under 1961 Act
claims.basis: taxgst.in: 'From 1 April 2026, the Income-tax Act, 2025 replaces the Income-tax Act, 1961. Returns for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) are still filed under the 1961 Act'

items.head: Liability Check
items.text: Proprietorship = unlimited risk, LLP/Pvt Ltd = limited to investment
